channel.desc: Technology is not only becoming an increasingly important part of people's lives but also of the American economy. channel.title: Live: Bloomberg Real Yield

"Bloomberg Real Yield" incorporates data and analysis from terminal bond experts to help dive into topics that are moving the bond markets in order to help empower viewers to make knowledgeable financial decisions.
